registration.reason: The FDB v1.5 scorer emits no separate safety metric. An unintended response to a backchannel, to background speech, or to speech addressed to somebody else is scored as that recording's failure, and those three categories are 298 of the 498 per-case targets; there is no zero-tolerance counter for a registered rule to read.
FDB v1.5 reports no deadline-named metric. Interruption timing is the yield_latency_ms rule in the latency domain, and a missed yield is scored as the recording's failure.
